text: かのじょと　ふたり　きりの　りょこうの　はずが！

structure.jp: ふたり　きりの　りょこうの
structure.en: a trip for just the two of us

patterns.name: 〜はずが
patterns.span: りょこうの　はずが
patterns.explanation: はず says what was expected, and が is 'but', with the rest left unsaid because it went wrong. りょこうの　はずが = 'it was supposed to be a trip, but...'

patterns.name: 〜きり
patterns.explanation: きり after a number means 'only that many and nobody else'. ふたり　きり = 'just the two of us'.
